changelog: Fixes the Reset abandoned episodes task failing immediately on Jellyfin 10.11.11 with a MissingMethodException. IUserManager.Users was a property up to 10.11.3 and is a GetUsers() method from 10.11.11, so one plugin binary cannot bind to either at compile time and still run on both halves of the 10.11 series. The user list is now asked for in whichever way the running server offers it. Filtering was never affected.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filters the server's response, changes no watch data.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
